headline: Ramayana's day could reach about 1.02M tickets, with its busiest hour still ahead around 11 PM–12 AM; Jailer 2 is running lower.
bullets: Ramayana: about 910K tickets so far, with the day expected to reach 1.02M (range 793K to 1.18M), 67% above yesterday. This is an opening-day forecast built from how earlier films behaved on release day and day two, so the range is wide.

The busiest hour still ahead is 11 PM–12 AM, at an expected 33.4K (range 25.1K to 37.4K), then 25.2K for 12–1 AM. Signals lean the forecast up by 9%, mainly from the BookMyShow rating (+7%) and critics (+3%); word of mouth and competing releases show 0%.

Tomorrow (Fri 6 Nov) is expected at 1.18M for Ramayana (range 826K to 1.78M), with new releases opening and Diwali on 8 Nov. Jailer 2 is expected at 25.2K tomorrow (range 21.7K to 34.4K) after about 23.9K today (range 22.8K to 25K), down 23% from yesterday.

Jailer 2 is in its later weeks, with about 679 tickets expected in the 11 PM–12 AM hour (range 595 to 759). No review or word-of-mouth signals are switched on for it, so its forecast is based on timing and history alone.
watch: Ramayana's word of mouth is mixed, and a weaker reception could pull its later-night and Friday numbers toward the low end of the range.
Competing Tamil releases open on 6 Nov; the model currently shows no effect from them, so a stronger pull could shift tomorrow's split.
